Mini Pea & Paneer Parathas

Start your week on a delicious note! We really think your kids will love these yummy Peas and Paneer parathas.

10 minPreparation
10 minCooking
2Servings

Ingredients

For 2 servings

Let’s make it.

  1. Combine all the ingredients, except ghee, in a bowl and knead into a soft dough.
  2. Cover and set aside for a few minutes.
  3. Divide the dough into 6 equal portions and roll out each portion into a 3-inch disc.
  4. Heat a non-stick pan and cook each paratha on both sides, brushing it with half a teaspoon ghee.
